_comment: Example rules for scripts/truth_check.py. Copy to .seo/truth-checks.json and replace with your own claims. Each rule greps the given paths: must_not_match patterns are contradictions (any hit is a finding), must_match patterns are claims that have to be present somewhere in the set. Patterns are regexes, so escape $ and \d. Add a rule every time a `correct` action fixes a live claim, so the same error can never come back silently.
